question: Where is the nearest gallery you’d find going toward Senior Helpers, Largo, FL starting at Sarasota Art Museum, Sarasota, FL?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.529024 27.325641)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.769703 27.919893)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'gallery'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.529024 27.325641)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.529024 27.325641)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;
